scope: Lossless passive Value::Dict representation only; no equality, comparison or product serialization changes
basis: compiler/eval.md:532-540 requires variant, all observable data, dict order and nested values. Existing lifecycle typed DTO represents Func as {Func:Identity} and Length as {Length:{abs_pt_bits,em_bits}}.

counterexample.right_runtime_variant: Value::Func whose passive identity is the same string
counterexample.claim: An untagged Dict object therefore is not injective. This proof uses the normative DTO vocabulary, not a candidate serializer.

Value_Dict.Dict: ordered array of [exact string key, recursively typed Value payload]

representation.rule: Every runtime Dict uses this wrapper, including a dictionary whose key is Dict. Never treat dictionary keys as runtime variant tags, sort entries, flatten wrappers or stringify unsupported values.
representation.other_variants: Preserve all existing typed carriers unchanged. Unknown unsupported variants remain an explicit binding gap.

verification: Independent verifier must exercise actual serializer binding on real Dict/Func/Length carriers and audit round-trip variant/order preservation. Authored JSON examples alone are not product observations or GREEN.
